questions.question: Are you interested in renting this accommodation?

responses.Yes: Yes, I'm interested in renting this accommodation.
responses.Not interested: No, I'm not interested in this accommodation.

questions.question: Where would you prefer to meet the agent for inspection?

responses.At the property location: I would prefer to meet at the property location.
responses.At a public place first: I would prefer to meet at a public place first.

questions.question: When would you be available for the meeting or inspection?
How many people will be coming with you for the inspection?
questions.response_template: {value} people will be coming with me for the inspection.

questions.question: Do you confirm to meet the agent on {meeting_date} at {meeting_location} for the accommodation inspection?

responses.Confirm and schedule: I confirm and would like to schedule the inspection.
responses.Cancel: I want to cancel the inspection.

questions.question: Are you interested in buying this product?

responses.Yes: Yes, I'm interested in buying this product.
responses.Not interested: No, I'm not interested in this product.

questions.question: How many units would you like to purchase?
questions.response_template: I would like to purchase {value} unit(s).

questions.question: What delivery method do you prefer? (NB: delivery charges may vary)

responses.Pickup at public location: I prefer to pick up at a public location.

questions.question: Provide the full address or pickup location for delivery.
When would you like the delivery to be made?
questions.response_template: I'd like the delivery to be made in {value}.

questions.question: You agreed to pay ₦{price} for {quantity} unit(s) of '{item_name}' to be delivered by {delivery_date}. Do you confirm?

responses.Confirm and pay: I confirm and would like to proceed with the payment.
responses.Cancel order: I want to cancel this order.

questions.question: A buyer is interested in renting your accommodation listing '{accommodation_title}'. Would you like to respond?

responses.No, already rented: No, the accommodation has already been rented out.

questions.question: The buyer prefers to meet {meeting_location}. Can you meet there?

responses.Yes, that works: Yes, that meeting location works for me.
responses.Suggest another location: I'd prefer a different meeting location.

questions.question: Please provide your preferred meeting location.
The buyer suggested meeting on {meeting_date}. Can you make that time?

responses.Yes, I'll be available: Yes, I'll be available at that time.
responses.No, suggest another time: No, I'd like to suggest another time.

questions.question: Please suggest a new meeting date and time.
Confirm meeting details: {meeting_date} at {meeting_location} for property inspection.

responses.Confirm and notify buyer: I confirm and will notify the buyer.
responses.Cancel appointment: I want to cancel the inspection appointment.

questions.question: A buyer is interested in your product '{item_name}'. Would you like to proceed?

responses.No, out of stock: No, the product is currently out of stock.

questions.question: How many units of this product are currently available?
The buyer prefers {delivery_method} to {buyer_delivery_location}. Can you deliver?

responses.Yes, I can deliver: Yes, I can deliver to the buyer's preferred location.
responses.No, buyer must pick up: No, the buyer will need to pick up the item.

questions.question: In how many days/hours can you deliver the order?
questions.response_template: I can deliver the order in {value}.

questions.question: Confirm sale of {quantity} unit(s) at ₦{final_price} each, to be delivered by {delivery_date}. Proceed?

responses.Cancel transaction: I want to cancel this transaction.
